name: round_plan
description: Circular-plan tower/wall (圆环墙/收分圆塔): stacked single-cell rings shrinking by `taper` per layer — taper=0 straight cylinder, 1 classic tower, 2+ steep cone. Each ring is a connected circle via patterns/ellipse.py circle_ring (共用圆栅格化, 禁止各写一份). `solid=true` fills the interior disc each layer so tapered rings never float (a tapered ring's new diagonal cells would hang over the layer below); `solid=false` keeps a hollow ring — use with taper=0. Optional `cap` disc seals the top. All geometry script-derived (禁止手改方向状态).
when_to_use: 圆塔/圆堡/穹顶塔身/灯塔/精灵圆屋/中世纪圆塔; 圆环柱廊(taper=0+solid=false)。origin = 底层圆心格, y = 地面层。elven_tree 圆屋主体用 solid=true(实心承重), 空心圆环墙用于柱廊/围合。搭配 crenellation/roof 放顶部。

origin.notes: 底层圆心格; y = 地面层

taper.notes: 每层半径缩减; 0=直筒 1=经典塔 2-3=陡锥

solid.notes: true=每层实心盘(收分塔支撑必需); false=空心环(配 taper=0)

cap.notes: 顶部封盘; false=开口留做垛口/屋顶

pitfalls: 收分塔(taper>0)必须 solid=true — 空心环收分时新对角块会悬空, support_check 必打回
空心圆环墙只配 taper=0 — 要空心又收分=悬空; 想收分请换 solid=true 实心塔
radius 别小于 2 — 半径 1 的环只剩单格, 不是圆墙
origin 必须取圆心格(y=地面) — 偏移圆心则整塔偏心, 落地不稳
cap=false 顶部是开口 — 若顶上要放屋顶/垛口, 别另盖实心盘冲突; 让接的卡自己封
example: python patterns/round_plan.py --params '{"origin":[100,64,100],"radius":4,"height":6,"taper":1}' --out tower.json && python patterns/round_plan.py --params '{"origin":[120,64,100],"radius":3,"height":5,"taper":0,"solid":false}' --out colonnade.json
